# Vinstkross från Paradox – förvaltaren om AI-rapporterna

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon (29 Oct 2026) covered the volatile AI trade, with guest fund manager Herman Olsson (Brock Milton) saying demand for compute still far exceeds supply even as Alphabet fell on a search miss and Microsoft rose on a broad beat. On the Swedish report flood, Paradox posted a strong quarter (adjusted for a one-off gain from selling Playrion) and was rewarded, while Engcon fell about 14% after a 20% organic order-intake drop in Europe. EFN analyst Ture Wester described the Stockholm market as strong, with money rotating from large caps to smaller companies, but said today's reports were mixed.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 PDX — Paradox Interactive | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong report, about 10% beat excluding the one-off, little currency effect. Strong 2027 release slate. Ture calls the 8% rise fair.

#### Reasoning

Ture (EFN analyst) says the report is fairly strong. Adjusted for the Playrion one-off, profit beat by about 10%, and the CEO says currency added little. CEO targets 40-45% EBIT margin, has a strong 2027 release pipeline, and uses AI to boost productivity. Fredrik Wester's large shareholding aligns him with shareholders. Ture thinks it can turn out well over time but calls the gaming sector hard to analyse.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 2027 releases disappoint
- if growth turns out to be mainly currency-driven
- if AI-driven game oversupply erodes willingness to pay

> *"Om man rensar för engångseffekten så är ändå avvikelsen över 10 procent skulle jag tro, på resultatet."*

---

### ⛔ ENGCON-B — Engcon | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Orders -20% organically in Europe, which is the growth focus. Ture calls the sell-off fair and does not see a buying opportunity yet.

#### Reasoning

Ture says the reaction is fair because order intake was much worse than expected and the turnaround under the returning CEO is delayed. Europe, the key growth market, is shrinking and France is a 'catastrophe'. He sees long-term potential but says it will not support today's valuation without signs of improvement soon. The CEO hopes simpler products and price increases show results in 2027 and expects a change by spring.

#### Sell Triggers

- if European order intake recovers
- if the simpler-product push in France, the UK and Germany gains traction
- if valuation falls enough to price in the weak outlook

> *"Ja, jag skulle säga att det är en ganska rättvis reaktion. I och med att ordergången är så pass mycket sämre än väntat."*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Search miss and cloud below buy-side expectations. Faces an innovator's dilemma vs OpenAI ads and Meta agents.

#### Reasoning

Herman Olsson (guest) calls it an overall fairly bad report apart from cloud (>100% growth, still below the 120% buy-side expectation). He worries that OpenAI ads and AI agents will hurt search and questions how well Google can defend itself. The 10% drop is close to its historical largest declines.

#### Sell Triggers

- if search revenue keeps missing
- if OpenAI ad revenue keeps scaling

> *"Överlag en ganska dålig rapport från Google. Jag är inte jätteförvånad att se den reaktionen."*

---

### 🟢 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Herman: memory makers became very cheap, are sold out for years, and say supply stays tight to 2030. Report slightly beat expectations.

#### Reasoning

The guest says Samsung and SK Hynix were sold off more than expected even though their capacity is locked in for coming years. Supply is guided as tight until 2030, which supports prices and earnings. Shareholder returns (buybacks and dividends) are the near-term share-price driver.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory pricing weakens
- if capital returns disappoint

> *"De har blivit väldigt, väldigt billiga och de har väl sålts ner, både Samsung och SG Hynix, mer än vad jag tror många hade förväntat sig."*

---

### 🟠 005930.KS — Samsung | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Down 5% on a roughly in-line report, but Herman sees it as cheap and sold out with tight supply to 2030. Focus is on capital returns.

#### Reasoning

The guest was surprised by the sell-off and sees cheap valuation plus tight supply until 2030. However, the report was slightly below expectations and the stock's direction hinges on shareholder returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- if buybacks and dividends disappoint
- if memory supply loosens before 2030

> *"Så jag var lite förvånad att de här aktierna faktiskt föll så mycket som har gjort."*

---

### 🟢 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Handelsbanken upgraded the stock from hold to buy (cited analyst view).

#### Reasoning

A cited analyst action, Handelsbanken's upgrade from hold to buy, read out in the news segment. No host view was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if copper prices fall

> *"Lundin Mining som får ny rekommendation från Handelsbanken från behåll till köp."*

---

### ⛔ FAG — Fagerhult | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Nordea cut its target price to 13 SEK from 18 SEK after the report-day plunge (cited analyst).

#### Reasoning

A cited analyst action: Nordea lowered its target price by about 28% after a weak report. No host view was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next report shows a recovery

> *"Fagerhult, de får sänkt riktkurs efter rapportdyket från Nordea till 13 från 18 kronor."*

---

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Fundamentally very strong report (Electrical orders ~+70%) held back by sentiment and valuation. Got a buy recommendation today.

#### Reasoning

Herman says the fundamentals are very strong and data-centre order concerns are unfounded, but high expectations and valuation capped the share. He sees signs of sentiment turning. An unnamed analyst issued a buy recommendation this morning.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre orders slow
- if the AI sentiment sell-off deepens

> *"Jag menar, ABB växer. Jag tror i Electrical där så är orderingången upp 70 %"*
